DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).

The combination of your significant smoking history (16 pack-years), episodic cough and shortness of breath, and the absence of heart failure symptoms (no ankle swelling, no orthopnea) strongly points to COPD.
